text: Lior Beres  to begin with it  happened to me  so it is true for me , in June 2026. In my personal experience and as a person that came here 20 years ago not yesterday ,  all of a sudden they asked me for the registration of my marriage in my home country and they left it written  in my file and I was even contacted about it via email , when I went the next time it was written there and they wouldn't want to continue unless I bring it I brought the law and changes that happened recently and they said it is only specific for certain countries blah blah blah. The OP is from my home country so I don't know if  it is related to our country but I brought the registration , I did all the stuff that they wanted and the situation was closed and kosher for them. Tbh, I was very surprised that they would ask such a thing after all these years  but indeed they wanted it and we fought it by not bringing it and it went against us because it delayed things. So there you go . Misrad Hapnim  being Misrad Hapnim. Shana tova
